author: Adventurous-Car8603
body:
Normal quality is 50/100, often referred to as 100%. A higher rating will have proportionally higher stats. A rating of 100/100 will be 200% and have double the stats of normal quality. 

The percentages was how everyone compared things before the appraiser was a thing and still used by many players. 

You dont always want the highest rating. There are 2 specializations that get bonus damage for low defense which means you want broken quality. These pieces are used for other stats or bonues from the gear. 

Masterforge and demonforge prices increase proportionally with rating as well. Mightiest minic head has 0 stats but gives orn, gold, exp, and luck bonuses. These bonuses all become the same no matter the quality at masterforged. With no stats its better to level up a standard quality as it will be cheaper to master and demonforge.

author: petr1petr
body:
appraiser will tell you, how good the item is.

each equip can be dropped with various quality. Normal quality is considered 100%, if it is ornate with best stats it may have, it is considered 200%. (note, that ingame appraiser goes with 100% scale and not 200%)

The issue is, that the color (or name) includes range of various % - so you cant really tell on first sight, if it is the best you could get, or if it is "only" very good. And thats where appraising becomes a thing. ingame or web based (discord). 

quality (dont exchange quality with rarity - thats something different) will influence stats - it may not influence bonuses. Quality also influence cost of upgrades (MF/DF). Sometimes, you are not after stats, but after bonuses - in this case, you dont need high quality.

most of the times, higher quality is better.
